deviations.reason: 3.40:1 fails 7:1 body text; tan kept decorative only
white on lighter tan is 3.88:1; deep tan is 5.84:1
6.65:1 on the footer band; raised to 7.94:1

rules: brush face used at exactly two places

taste.name: Photography carries the emotion, colour carries nothing
taste.trigger: a church must feel warm without illustration and without faces
taste.decision: all warmth lives in full-bleed photos and a cream paper tone; interface stays within five flat colours and 1px rules
taste.reason: chrome warmth reads as decoration and dates; photo warmth reads as the place
taste.evidence: 5 heroes, 5 photographs, 0 gradients; every UI surface is #f1e8e0, #fbf8f4 or #f3e8de

taste.name: Two families with a single brush exception
taste.trigger: Traditional Chinese titles need gravity, body copy needs 19px legibility
taste.decision: serif for titles and names, sans for anything longer than a line, brush used exactly twice
taste.reason: a brush face at 3 places is identity, at 20 places it is a gimmick and it breaks scanning
taste.evidence: 願平安與你同在 appears in brush in the hero and the footer, never in nav, buttons or headings
taste.restraintTradeoff: reference could have set all five page titles in brush; it did not, which keeps service rows skimmable

taste.name: Pill buttons, because the audience is not 25
taste.trigger: most of the congregation is over 60 and presses buttons on a phone
taste.decision: every action is a 44–48px pill, filled tan primary, outlined secondary, never a bare text link
taste.reason: a capsule reads as pressable at arm's length and survives a 48px tap target without looking wrong
taste.evidence: 4 pill CTAs across the panels, 0 primary actions as bare text

taste.name: The page structure is a questionnaire, not a brochure
taste.trigger: a visitor arrives with three questions: when, where, who are you
taste.decision: hero, then four index cards, then the service row in full; address never leaves the footer
taste.reason: a church site is interrogated rather than read, so each block ends one question
taste.evidence: times appear twice on the home panel; footer repeats address and phone on all five panels; every subpage carries a breadcrumb

rejected: second accent colour (Facebook blue appears in the reference footer)
